title: When life is at risk, donor blood is not always there.
intro: Across the living world, extraordinary species face unique challenges. Even with the best care, access to donor blood can be limited, precisely when it is needed most.

image.alt: Snow leopard representing species diversity and wildlife health

cards.title: Species diversity
cards.text: Stronger species help safeguard both nature and people.

image.alt: Elephant representing remote wildlife care and operational realities

cards.title: Operational reality
cards.text: In remote areas, donor supply, storage, and logistics can be limited or unavailable.

image.alt: Wild landscape representing the oxygen-delivery gap in remote care

cards.title: Oxygen-delivery gap
cards.text: Oxygen-delivery options may bridge critical needs when donor blood is unavailable or delayed.
